edition.cue: Serve the breakfast feast when Phil gorges at the diner.

s.note: Warm cake doughnuts shaken in a paper bag with cinnamon sugar.
s.how: Warm 4 small plain cake doughnuts at 160°C conventional for 2 minutes. Put 30g caster sugar and 1/2 tsp cinnamon in a clean food-safe paper bag. Add the warm doughnuts and shake gently until coated. Serve one each.

s.note: Boiled egg halves with creamy mustard yolks, hot sauce and paprika.
s.how: Boil 4 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water and peel. Halve and remove the yolks. Whip the yolks with 30g mayonnaise, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1/2 tsp hot sauce and 1/4 tsp smoked paprika until smooth. Pipe back into the eight white halves and refrigerate until serving.

m.note: Crisp bacon, fried eggs, pancakes, buttered toast and a slice of pie.
m.how: Mix 150g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 15g caster sugar, 1 egg and 200ml buttermilk into a batter. Rest 15 minutes. Render 200g bacon slowly in a frying pan over medium heat for 10 minutes until crisp and keep warm. Cook eight small pancakes in 20g butter for about 2 minutes per side until bubbles set and both sides are golden. Fry 4 eggs in the bacon pan for 3 minutes, or until the whites are set. Toast 4 slices white bread and butter with 20g butter. Warm four small 50g slices ready-baked pie at 180°C for 10 minutes. Bring everything to the table at once, with 60ml maple syrup for the pancakes.

w.note: Light egg white sponge with fresh berries and softly whipped cream.
w.how: Whisk 5 egg whites with 1/4 tsp cream of tartar to soft peaks. Gradually add 75g caster sugar and whisk until glossy. Sift 60g cake flour with 75g icing sugar, then gently fold into the whites in three additions. Spoon into an ungreased 16cm tube pan. Bake at 175°C conventional for 40 minutes until golden and springy. Invert the tin and cool upside down completely before loosening the cake. Cut into four portions and serve with 150g fresh berries and 80ml thickened cream softly whipped.

d.note: Fresh drip coffee in thick mugs, ready for another refill.
d.how: Brew 60g ground coffee with 1 litre hot water through a drip filter for about 4 minutes. Serve in four thick mugs and keep the remainder warm for refills. Put 100ml full cream milk on the table for anyone who wants it.
